update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.26 - Career selection loop fix
Fixes --- - Run legacy parent selection before owned support equip so parent changes do not wipe supports and re-open pickers - Close support/parent scroll lists after failed card match instead of leaving the picker open - Cap parent and owned-deck retries so career prep advances to borrow/start instead of looping forever
Includes v5.9.25 scrollbar crash fix and v5.9.24 parent farming hotfixes.
